audit.whatIsWrong: The page rates the lane 'HARD' in diff but paints it green, scores it 4/10, calls it a 'Favoured matchup' in the final rating, and gives Urgot five of seven chart rows at 8/10.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror settles it: Urgot keeps levels 1-2 on Corrosive Charge's 800 range and Echoing Flames, level 3 is a skill row, and levels 4-5, 6, first item and 2+ items all go to Illaoi. That also resolves the internal contradiction — a HARD lane cannot also be 'Favoured'. Chart rows are proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings, tone and the difficulty text moved together.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Urgot / Urgot / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi; diffRating 7/10, tone #ff8b3d, final rating and difficulty line rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit is named on a dozen lines with no cooldown, and the range picture that decides the lane is never given.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range, Tentacle Smash 10/9/8/7/6s at 850, Harsh Lesson a 4s leap at 400, Leap of Faith 120/95/70s at 450. Against that, Purge needs you inside 490 and slows Urgot himself while it channels, Disdain reaches 475 on 16s at rank 1, and Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1. Her poke simply outranges your damage, which is why the mid rows are hers.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and the 850-versus-490 range gap now carry the level whys, the cooldown block and the mid text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims four times that Fear Beyond Death 'flips her out of her tentacle field' and 'cancels her Leap of Faith setup'. Neither is in the kit. Missing entirely: Harsh Lesson is a 4s auto-attack reset, and her passive heals her whenever a tentacle damages a champion.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death impales the first enemy champion hit and executes below a threshold — it does not reposition Urgot and nothing in the text cancels or displaces her ult. The tentacle healing is the reason chip damage does not close the lane, which makes Grievous Wounds timing the real purchase. The Harsh Lesson reset means the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step out.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late and wants.you[2] rewritten around what the ult actually does; report[5].t now states the Harsh Lesson reset; anti-heal stated in spikes[3] and late.

audit.why: The kit file flags 'grounding' and 'untargetable' on Leap of Faith, but Riot's description says only that it damages nearby enemies and spawns a tentacle per champion hit. Treated as a tooltip-parse misfire (as the mirror did) and no grounding or untargetability claim was written.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Test of Spirit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by whether you dodge Test of Spirit and refuse every fight inside her tentacles.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Illaoi carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Illaoi carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Dodging this is the whole matchup. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Test of Spirit: 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range. Dodge it and she has no real trade for the next 16 seconds.

edits.before: Track Illaoi's Test of Spirit: Dodging this is the whole matchup. When it is down — W-shred + execute her.
edits.after: Harsh Lesson is a 4s leap that resets her auto — the wind-up is your cue to step out, not the cast.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Black Cleaver  (shred + the leg tempo), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — cuts his healing.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Black Cleaver  (shred + the leg tempo), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — cuts her healing.

edits.before: Level 3-5 favours you because spacing lets your Purge shred her while her slams whiff.
edits.after: Level 3 is a coin flip — Tentacle Smash reaches 850 while Purge needs 490.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours as you out-DPS her passive healing in clean fights.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 turn: tentacles heal her off you and Test of Spirit is 16s.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you since R flips her out of her tentacle field and executes.
edits.after: Level 6 is hers: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle for every champion hit.

edits.before: First item favours you as you shove her in and deny her E snowball.
edits.after: First item is hers — her tentacle healing outlasts your chip damage.

edits.before: With 2+ items you win — your shred outpaces her regen and R cancels her ult engage.
edits.after: With 2+ items the side lane is hers — tentacle healing beats your shred.

edits.before: Use R to flip her away and cancel her Leap of Faith setup
edits.after: Save R to finish her, not as an answer to Leap of Faith

edits.before: R Fear Beyond Death is huge here: it flips Illaoi out of her own tentacle field and executes her, and turning her away breaks the very setup her ult Leap of Faith needs to spawn a wall of slams.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1 and it impales rather than repositions you — spend it on an Illaoi already low from a trade, not as an answer to Leap of Faith, which she casts at 450 with her tentacles already up.

edits.before: The matchup stays yours: as a tank-shredder you melt Illaoi's HP faster than her tentacles regen it, and R plus your leg execute punish her the moment she commits Leap of Faith into your team.
edits.after: The side lane turns hers: tentacles heal her off you faster than your chip lands, so hold Grievous Wounds and commit only with Fear Beyond Death up and her already under its threshold.

edits.before: Levels 2-6 are yours as long as you space well. Your Q slow lets you sit at the range where her tentacles whiff but your Purge grinds her down, and you out-DPS her passive healing in any clean fight. At 6, R Fear Beyond Death is the trump card — flip her out of her tentacle field, cancel her Leap of Faith setup, and execute if she's low.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are yours if you space well: Corrosive Charge slows from 800 and keeps you outside her swings while Echoing Flames chips her. From 4 it turns — Purge needs you inside 490 and slows you while it channels, which is exactly where her tentacles want you standing. Trade only once Test of Spirit, 16s at rank 1, has been spent.

edits.before: First item keeps you ahead: you shove her in, deny the spirit-grabs she needs to scale, and out-sustain her in straight duels. With 2+ items you stay in control — your shred melts her tank build faster than tentacles heal it, and R punishes every Leap of Faith engage by flipping her out before her slams stack on your team.
edits.after: First item is hers: the tentacle healing outlasts your chip damage, so hold Grievous Wounds before any long fight. With 2+ items the side lane stays hers too, so take your game to grouped objectives instead — there Fear Beyond Death finishes someone already low, rather than opening a duel you have to win alone.

notes: suspectNames false positive: 'Ult Leap of Faith' in wants.foe[2] is the correct Riot name. Packet inconsistency worth knowing: the header says games 925 but packet.games says 888, and the mirror records a 52.97% Illaoi win rate over 925 games against this packet's 50.56% for Urgot — the two packets do not agree, which is why the chart was taken from the mirror. Kit-flag misfires: 'grounding' and 'untargetable' on Leap of Faith are unsupported by its description; Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) is tagged 'dash' but has no movement.
